specification.target: Eligible emitted-label error; no GT/category/identity predictor
specification.hierarchy: Equal source -> equal eligible official GT trajectory -> equal observation; recompute for each training subset
specification.selection: 5 deterministic source-group outer folds; 3 inner folds per outer train; select concatenated inner OOF hierarchical Brier. Candidates within 1e-5 of minimum use declared grid order.
specification.ridge: Weighted mean BCE + .5*lambda*||beta_features||^2; train-only weighted standardization; unpenalized intercept

HGB.sample_weight: n_train * hierarchy_weights; l2 uses that scale

specification.calibrator: Fixed Platt on selected candidate's inner OOF predictions, weighted BCE + .5*1e-4*(intercept^2+(slope-1)^2); intercept [-20,20], slope [0,10]. Refit base on whole training subset. Outer/tune outcomes never calibrate their own predictions.
specification.primary: B3_nested_Platt; always report raw B2 too, never choose between them on outer/tune
specification.final: All-fit 3 inner source-group folds choose candidate and fit OOF calibrator; refit all fit, then predict tune once

bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional on frozen predictions; no model refit or training-uncertainty claim

specification.gate: Hard mean-risk control only. Does not qualify wrong-evidence vector centering, pair-dependence prediction, final tracking efficacy or novelty.
